title: Tennessee blocks Gamma's orange completion
description: Tennessee blocks Gamma's orange completion. Tennessee is a defensive buy: auctioning gives Gamma the strongest traffic set. A shallow policy would choose start_auction; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.

I can later trade for red group or develop later. Auction would likely be won by Beta at a higher price, so purchase is the optimal move.
